packs.name: Crisis Comfort & Psychological First Aid

packs.name: Field Fixes & Improvised Repairs
packs.summary: Fast fixes for when things break and the store is closed: leaking lines and radiators, a snapped belt, a flat with no jack, no pump, no light, no coat. From the Army repair, rigging, and survival manuals where they exist, and marked "not yet sourced" where a trick is only hand-me-down.
